description:
Write 20 to 40 titles for your video, each borrowing the device and structure of one
    real outlier (a video that beat its own channel): the finds of one of your runs, or the
    shared index's videos nearest your topic by meaning. Each title: title, chars, first_40
    (what a phone feed surely shows), device, borrows, and from (the real outlier: video_id,
    title, channel, multiple, find_id). best: the five whose outlier beat its channel the
    most among the devices the outliers share (best_basis says so; never a predicted
    click-through rate). label: written by Hook Detector, never a real video's title.
    Costs 1 credit, refunded when the writing fails; fewer than 5 outliers known is 422
    too_few_outliers and costs nothing (run find_packaging on the topic first). Same as POST
    /v1/titles. Read it back with get_call.

channel.description: optional @handle whose style to write in
channel.title: Channel

content_type.description: for a topic: long (default) or short
content_type.title: Content Type

idempotency_key.description: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters; the same key and request within 24 hours answer the saved remix and charge nothing; the same key with another request is 422 idempotency_key_reused
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

run_id.description: a finished Packaging or Long form run of yours: its finds are the sources
run_id.title: Run Id

topic.description: the subject of your video, 3 to 300 characters (the outliers come from the shared index); send this or run_id
topic.title: Topic

name: write_titles
